frozen_before_results: No candidate output existed when these files were built. Any change to a task, prompt or decoding setting is a new benchmark version.

generation.seed: first 8 bytes of sha256(task id), big-endian
generation.thinking: disabled: enable_thinking=False is passed to every chat template

word_sentences.feature: word to example sentences in context

condense.feature: sentence: same meaning in fewer words

academic.feature: sentence: more academic, no new claims

source.author: Written for this benchmark by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) in a Pari session on 2026-10-16. Not user text and not copied from any essay corpus.
source.quotes: Every quotation comes from a public-domain work and is listed on its paragraph. Paragraphs about copyrighted books describe the plot and quote nothing.

screen_and_full_disjoint: No paragraph or sentence appears in both sets.

reused: word_studio_output_parser.py: parse_document, partial_option_values and near_duplicate_keys parse the JSON options, flag wrapper prose and fences, recover options from a partial stream, and find near duplicates.
The JSON {"options": [...]} output contract from the v1 suites.
The global rules of v1-prompt-contracts.json: keep facts, negation and certainty; invent nothing; return options only.
not_reused: word-studio-transform-suite.jsonl: its sources are short everyday sentences, not essay paragraphs, and its operations (split/join, collocation, a vocabulary ceiling that penalises academic wording) do not match the v1 features, where 'more academic' is now a feature.
word-studio-strength-suite.jsonl: the 15/40/60/90 strength slider is not a v1 feature.
word_studio_human_eval.py: human review packets are replaced by Claude blind judging (#87).

run-kaggle-roster.py and the vLLM/Prism runners: they depend on the archived English Core lane, on a module that no longer exists (kaggle_stage_identity) and on prebuilt runtime locks. v2 uses one Transformers runner (#86).
